name: Chat Board
description: A kanban of your agent chats (Claude, Cursor, Codex tabs) across every workspace, with your own columns and live agent status.

settings.title: Show agent logo
settings.description: Claude / Cursor logo (or agent name) on each card.

settings.title: Show workspace
settings.description: Workspace name chip on each card.

settings.title: Show agent status icon
settings.description: Working, waiting for you, done, interrupted, needs permission.

settings.title: Show time since last change
settings.description: How long ago the agent changed status or the chat last printed output.

settings.title: Show notes
settings.description: The note you wrote on a card, under its title.

settings.title: Language
settings.description: Auto follows Orca's language (Spanish for es-*, English otherwise).
